other_conditions: Applicant must be a student pursuing regular full‑time professional or technical courses in a recognized institution in India or abroad.
benefits_summary: Provides a loan up to ₹30 lakhs for studies in India or up to ₹40 lakhs abroad (or 90% of course fee) at subsidized interest rates, with repayment periods of up to 10–12 years.
application_link: Step 1: Contact the District Office of State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs). Step 2: Submit the NSFDC application format with details at the District Office. Step 3: SCAs/CAs scrutinize applications for eligibility. Step 4: Forward scrutinized applications to Head Offices. Step 5: Head Offices examine proposals and forward recommendations to NSFDC. Step 6: NSFDC’s Project and Banking Desk appraises proposals and submits report to the Project Clearance Committee (PCC). Step 7: PCC reviews and recommends sanctions; Letters of Intent are issued to SCAs/RRBs/Public Sector Banks/NBFC‑MFIs. Step 8: Funds are disbursed by NSFDC to SCAs/RRBs/Public Sector Banks/NBFC‑MFIs, which then disburse to beneficiaries. Step 9: Beneficiaries repay loans as per the repayment schedule.
